metadata.title: Infinitesimmaly homogeneous manifolds with symplectic and almost contact structure groups
metadata.abstract: We study infinitesimally homogeneous affine manifolds with prescribed structure groups. First, for the real symplectic group $\operatorname{Sp}(2n,\mathbb R)$, we prove that the corresponding infinitesimally homogeneous structures are precisely flat torsion-free symplectic affine structures. Second, for \(\operatorname{U}(n)\times\{1\}\), whose \(G\)-structures are equivalent to almost contact metric data, we classify the torsion-free characteristic tensors and obtain the general torsional case by invariant deformation. The admissible torsion and inner-torsion parameters are governed by a single algebraic relation, and the horizontal distribution is contact precisely when a certain combination of these parameters does not vanish. We also describe the compatible connections and relate the torsion-free branches to trans-Sasakian geometry.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 刻画辛群结构下的无穷小齐性仿射流形，并分类几乎接触结构群下的无挠特征张量及由不变变形获得的有挠情形。
techniques: 挠率与内挠率代数关系
analysis.breakthrough: 统一连接辛平坦结构、几乎接触结构与 trans-Sasakian 分支。
analysis.limitations: 结果限定指定结构群及无穷小齐性，接触判据取决于特定参数组合。 数学分析仅依据摘要及评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索和命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
